title: Survival as a Barbarian — Prologue
style: Cinematic 2D manhwa / Korean webtoon, painterly digital illustration, no on-screen captions, no speech bubbles, no subtitles, no UI text overlays.
global_audio_rules: All novel narration is spoken voice-over, never burned into the picture. No subtitle bars. Dialogue from the protagonist is a tired young Korean-American / Korean male voice in English, close-mic, intimate. Pixel-game UI sounds stay diegetic. Music is non-diegetic.
chain: Each clip's last frame is the next clip's first frame (FL2VA). After generation, extract the true last video frame and optionally re-use it. Concatenate with ffmpeg xfade 6 frames.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. A pale young man lies in a sunlit hospital bed, messy dark hair, white hospital gown, playing a handheld game. Dust motes in a diagonal sunbeam. IV stand, quiet ward. Camera slowly pushes in as his thumbs tap. He speaks softly, wry: "I've loved games since I was young." [Shot 2] Slightly closer, years implied by the same bed, same light. He keeps playing, a tired half-smile. Voice-over: "I was always in the hospital, so gaming was the only thing to do. As time went on, it became a part of my life." No captions, no speech bubbles, no Korean SFX lettering.

overall_soundscape: Distant hospital HVAC, faint heart-monitor beep, plastic button clicks of a handheld console, linen rustle, intimate dry voice-over.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse melancholic piano, slow, warm analog hiss, very low under the voice.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa action collage: a red-haired armored warrior lunges with a silver longsword through sparks in a dark cavern — treated as a game the protagonist is playing, not on-screen text. Camera tracks the slash. The young man off-screen snaps: "Ah, shit… Is this AI for real? Why would it heal that guy there?" [Shot 2] The fantasy combat continues then dulls; motion loses energy, colors flatten. Voice-over, exhausted: "At some point, no matter what game I played, it wasn't as fun as it used to be. AOS, RPG, FPS — all garbage. The stories were cliché. I wanted something more special." No genre labels, no HUD text, no captions.

overall_soundscape: Sword clash, fire sparks, then the mix thinning; frustrated breath; chair creak.

non_diegetic_music: Aggressive game-like drums that lose the beat and decay into a hollow drone.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. A dim room, a monitor or phone filling with a retro indie title: a 2D pixel dungeon crawler, English UI only as in-world game pixels, never as comic captions. The young man's eyes catch the light. Voice-over: "That's when I discovered Dungeon and Stone. An overseas indie. Single-player RPG. 2D pixels. Didn't even support Korean." [Shot 2] He installs it anyway, clicking through. Keyboard clacks. A small reluctant smirk. "It was free, so I tried it. Before long, I was completely hooked." No webtoon narration boxes.

overall_soundscape: Mouse click, installer chime, 8-bit dungeon ambience leaking from cheap speakers, keyboard tatat.

non_diegetic_music: Curious lo-fi 8-bit motif blooming under piano.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa mixed with top-down pixel dungeon. NPC companions, a priest almost wiping the run. The young man leans into the screen, whispering: "Wow, that damn Priest almost got me killed right at the end." [Shot 2] Permadeath sting — the pixel hero falls. Camera holds on the player's tense hands. Voice-over: "When your character died, you had to start over from the beginning. Companions were essential. High freedom. The world was interesting even in English. It had something I couldn't explain." No comic balloons, no 'YOU DIED' as a caption overlay unless it is tiny diegetic pixel game UI inside the game window.

overall_soundscape: Pixel sword hits, party footsteps, a grim 8-bit death sting, frustrated laugh.

non_diegetic_music: Dark adventure strings mixed with chiptune, rising then cutting.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. Years of nights: the same player hunched over Dungeon and Stone, subway uniform folded nearby. Combat is judgment, not HP bars. Voice-over: "Even at full health, one mistake could wipe a character I had spent three months building." [Shot 2] Pixel hero face-down under a dungeon spotlight. He mutters: "…Let's do this." After two years stuck before the midpoint, he swallows his pride. No English caption cards around the frame, no phone status bar.

overall_soundscape: Low 8-bit dungeon wind, a heavy pixel death thud, subway rumble far away, determined inhale.

non_diegetic_music: Slow funeral chiptune converting into stubborn drums.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa montage: translating English strategy pages, sparse forums, shaking his head. Voice-over: "It didn't show up on Korean portals. Overseas posts weren't helpful. I understood this game deeper than people who quit after two months." [Shot 2] He gives up on guides. Top-down dungeon corridor. He recites a path under his breath: "Up three times, left four times, down once, left twice, up again six times, right four times. Finally, avoid the trap… okay." Nine years of life flash as tiny stills on the monitor bezel — discharge day, campus, a job offer — while he never stops playing. No on-screen paragraphs.

overall_soundscape: Page-scroll, keyboard, dungeon footsteps in exact counted rhythm, distant campus chatter bleeding in.

non_diegetic_music: Time-lapse piano ostinato, years stacking.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. Pixel character stands before a vast dark portal: Gate of the Abyss. The player's fingertips are stiff on the keys. He exhales: "Phew." Then, almost sacred: "The final boss…." Voice-over: "To someone else it might be nothing. It took me nine years to get here. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say it was with me through all of my twenties." [Shot 2] The character steps closer. The portal breathes like a living void. Camera slowly pushes into the gate. No comic captions.

overall_soundscape: Sub-bass portal hum, sparse drip in a stone hall, heartbeat in the mix, dry swallow.

non_diegetic_music: Choir-like pads, held notes, dread and awe.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. In-world pixel dialogue only inside the game window: Will you enter? He clicks YES without hesitation. A second, grander warning: You may not be able to return. Are you sure? He scoffs under his breath: "From a player's perspective, unnecessary drama. Like I wouldn't enter at this point?" [Shot 2] Cursor on Yes. Click. Screen cuts to a black loading void. No webtoon speech bubbles, no outer narration boxes — only diegetic game pixels if needed.

overall_soundscape: Classic RPG confirm beep, heavier warning chord, mouse click, fans spinning up.

non_diegetic_music: Silence then a single low brass hit on the click.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. Close on the young man's face lit by a black monitor, pupils tight. Internal voice, racing: "How many patterns will this guy have? Attributes? Instant-kill for sure. I'll give up on the first try and gather information." [Shot 2] His reflection warps in the dark glass. Excitement and dread. No captions. The loading void on the monitor begins to glow from inside, too bright for a game.

overall_soundscape: PC coil whine, his breathing, a rising electrical tone from the monitor.

non_diegetic_music: Tight ticking percussion under a rising synth that shouldn't be coming from the game.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. The black monitor types diegetic system messages in clean English then suddenly Korean, light spilling into the room: You have reached the Abyss. Tutorial complete. He freezes. Voice, confused: "Tutorial complete? No — more importantly, why is this in Korean? Dungeon and Stone only supported English." [Shot 2] Commencing transfer. The screen becomes a physical blast of white. He throws an arm up, shouting: "Agh, fuck! My eyes!" No comic lettering, no outer caption cards; the system lines exist only as in-world monitor light.

overall_soundscape: Harsh UI blip in Korean TTS-like tone, rising whine, then a blinding broadband flash, his shout, ringing tinnitus.

non_diegetic_music: Cuts out on the flash, replaced by ear-ring drone.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D manhwa. Total white, heat on skin, anesthetic fade. Camera holds in the void. Voice-over, dissolving: "I was usually confident in a crisis. In this moment I had no clue." [Shot 2] Flash. Consciousness drops. Then eyelids open onto black — a new place, crowd murmur somewhere far, a stunned inhale. He does not speak. End on darkness and the feeling of having arrived. No congratulations captions, no speech bubbles, no Korean SFX drawings.

overall_soundscape: Tinnitus, body-heat whoosh, then distant muffled crowd murmur, a gasp, stone-hall reverb.

non_diegetic_music: After silence, a new low adventure drone, unresolved.
